title: A Horizon for the Summit
author: Cyrus Okafor
blurb: Bram Okafor, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
